summary: MSVC CRT unsigned 64-bit division-with-remainder helper (__aulldvrm) returning the remainder a1 mod a2. Mirrors aulldiv's normalization path but reconstructs the full divisor*quotient product and returns a1 minus that product; the 32-bit-divisor fallback returns a 64/32 mod using the native div instruction.

operations.description: Branch on the high 32 bits of divisor a2 being nonzero; if set, take the full 64-bit normalization path.
Normalize: shift the 64-bit divisor right one bit at a time while its high word is nonzero, rotating the low bits into v5; shift the dividend v6 right in lockstep.
Estimate the quotient (v6 / v5) and compute the partial product v9 = (unsigned)a2 * (v6 / v5), then fold in the high-word contribution v8 = HIDWORD(a2) * (v6 / v5) with carry detection.
If the product carried or the assembled 64-bit product v9 exceeds a1, subtract a2 once to correct the product.
Return a1 - v9, the remainder of the unsigned 64-bit division.
Fallback path when the divisor fits in 32 bits: build v2 from the low 32 bits of a1 and (HIDWORD(a1) mod (unsigned)a2) as the high word, then return v2 mod (unsigned)a2.

clean_pseudocode: unsigned int hd = a2 >> 32, ld = (unsigned int)a2;
